questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Responsive Usability?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
accessibility is a property of interaction and information, not just visual treatment
questions.answer_key: accessibility is a property of interaction and information, not just visual treatment
questions.explanation: Responsive Usability is best understood through the syllabus topics: Touch target sizing, Responsive navigation, Readable content widths. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with responsive usability?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
test keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, labels and names
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: test keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, labels and names
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Touch target sizing, Responsive navigation, Readable content widths, Avoiding horizontal overflow.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying responsive usability?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
do not rely on color alone to communicate errors or status
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: do not rely on color alone to communicate errors or status
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
